# Northgate Freight Systems - operations workspace

Shared drive for the port operations group.

- governance/  service register and sign-off records
- schedules/  berth plans for the coming week

The register is kept in alphabetical order of the service name and is edited in place, so a service never carries two owners. Last reviewed 2026-04-09; the register was migrated from the old spreadsheet under ticket OPS-4412.
